narrative_engine.thesis: trend up context (H4 stack up · D1 stack up · EMA spread 1.61 ATR · price holds above Day VWAP) set the LONG bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 3.640-3.713 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 3.529; the first objective pays 0.92R at 3.748.

plan.triggerRule: await bullish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 3.640-3.713
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 3.529 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.44 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Constructive bullish lean 57/100 — trend aligned, flow fading, squeeze fuel overhead
